risks.risk: Brand/model may be different from what the seller claims (affects comparable pricing).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the frame badge/branding and any serial/model plate (or the head tube/seat tube text).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic front-suspension sport bicycle (worst-case vs claimed brand/model).

risks.risk: Mechanical condition (brake rub, gear shifting accuracy, chain wear, wheel trueness) is unknown from one wide photo.
risks.proof: Short video: ride test + gear shifting through all gears + brake test (front and rear), plus close-ups of chain and brake pads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing basic service/unknown condition (worst-case: not fully working smoothly).

risks.risk: Wheel/tire condition (tire wear, sidewall cracks, punctures) and rim damage are not clearly visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tires and rims (tread wear, cracks), and a photo of the valve area; include a spin test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tires/rims may need replacement or repair.

risks.risk: Suspension health (leaks, seized stanchions, weak rebound) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Video of front suspension compressing and rebounding (slow push + release) and close-up of fork seals.
risks.if_unproven: Price as suspension may be weak/needs service.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the frame branding/model text (head tube/seat tube) and any serial/model plate.
Video ride test showing shifting through all gears and both brakes working properly.
Close-up photos of chain, cassette/freewheel, derailleur(s), and brake pads.
Close-up photos of tires and rims (tread wear, cracks) plus a wheel spin test.
response.reason: The photo confirms a front suspension bicycle, but brand/model and drivetrain specification are not readable, and mechanical condition (gears/brakes/suspension/tires) is unknown—so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the key proof shots.
